experiment: Voxel session F: combined-paper feasibility probe (W0/W2/W3) on RTX 4090, A100 80 GB and H100
status_at_declaration: Declared before any session F rental. One byte-identical package runs on each GPU type; one rental per type.
questions: Q1 counters: can Nsight Compute read performance counters on each rented GPU (no ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM)?
Q2 stack: does Yang et al.'s pinned GMG (fd9ddecd) install and pass its own smoke test unchanged?
Q3 integration: inside their GMG, do the fused_ai_fp64 and modal8_muladd arms reproduce the stock FP64 operator and solve?
Q4 sizing: how large a cantilever fits, per GPU, solver schedule and arm (peak memory, setup and per-iteration time)?

sizing.stop_rule: for each run, stop the ladder at the first size that fails (out of memory, error or timeout)

decision.counters_available: ncu exits 0 and its output contains no ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM; recorded per GPU
decision.integration_ok: for every grid, density field, schedule and non-stock arm: product relative L2 <= 1e-12 against stock; solve converged; true residual (stock operator) <= 1e-10; solution relative L2 against the stock solution <= 1e-8
decision.sizing: descriptive only; it sets the W1/W2 size targets, which are frozen in their own protocols

not_claimed: No timing in this session is a speedup claim: runs are single, unrepeated and unrandomized.
Counter values from this probe are exploratory; W3 declares its own protocol.
Compatibility is not a speedup, and a speedup is not novelty.
